variety_description: An early maturity, medium height variety, developed by CRURRS, Hazaribagh in 2002 and recommended for direct seeding under upland and rainfed conditions. It has long bold grain and average grain yield. Suitable for drought prone and acidic soil areas, especially in Odisha, Jharkhand and Bihar. Tolerant to major diseases, lodging and shattering.
